description.en: A sturdy and reliable blade.
description.zh-Hant: 一把堅固且可靠的劍。

description.en: The Diamond Sword is the true mark of a hero and an accomplished adventurer.
description.zh-Hant: 擁有一把鉆石劍是一個英雄或經驗豐富的冒險家的標配。

description.en: The Hawkbrand is the legendary sword of proven warriors.
description.zh-Hant: 被認可的勇士才能佩戴傳奇鷹身大劍。

description.en: The Sinister Sword, drawn to those who face the spookiest of nights, cuts through the night with a howl.
description.zh-Hant: 邪惡之劍會吸引直面夜晚中最恐怖的東西的人，用一聲尖叫劈開夜色。

description.en: Those strong enough to wield the Anchor in battle follow the tradition of legendary seafaring warriors.
description.zh-Hant: 那些強大到可以在戰斗中揮動船錨的人一直遵循著傳說的航海戰士傳統。

description.en: This Encrusted Anchor was lost at sea long ago and has become harsh and corrosive during its ages of neglect.
description.zh-Hant: 這個覆藤船錨已經在海上遺失了許久，經過漫長歲月，它已磨得犀利和帶有腐蝕性。

description.en: The axe is an effective weapon, favored by the relentless Vindicators of the Arch-Illager's army.
description.zh-Hant: 斧是一把十分有效的武器，受到奇厄大軍中無情衛道士的青睞。

description.en: Crafted in the blackest depths of the Fiery Forge and enchanted with fiery powers.
description.zh-Hant: 鑄造于烈焰鍛造廠的最黑最深處，擁有烈焰的力量。

description.en: Expertly crafted and a polished weapon of war, the Highland Axe also makes a daring backscratcher.
description.zh-Hant: 高地之斧的制作工藝精湛，是一種光鮮的戰爭武器，也是一種大膽的反擊手段。

description.en: The preferred blade of thieves and assassins, the Backstabber is a must in any rogue's pack.
description.zh-Hant: 作為盜賊和刺客的首選，背刺利刃是所有流氓的囊中必備。

traits.zh-Hant: 對毫無戒備的敵人造成額外傷害

description.en: A blade for those who know that the surest way to victory is to strike without being seen.
description.zh-Hant: 對于那些認識到隱蔽自身并乘機偷襲才是制勝之道的人來說，這是絕佳的選擇。

traits.zh-Hant: 對毫無戒備的敵人造成額外傷害

description.en: The battlestaff is a perfectly balanced staff that is ready for any battle.
description.zh-Hant: 戰斗之杖哪都不弱，適用于任何戰爭。

description.en: This staff overwhelms its target in battle to explosive effect.
description.zh-Hant: 這根手杖為了取得爆炸性的效果，將目標壓制得不敢反抗分毫。

description.en: A staff that grows and shifts as it attacks, the Growing Staff is unpredictable and powerful.
description.zh-Hant: 生長之杖會隨攻擊生長並變形，難以捉摸且威力強大。

traits.zh-Hant: 提升對受傷生物的傷害

description.en: Those who wield a Bone Club prefer a less-subtle approach to problem-solving.
description.zh-Hant: 使用大骨棍的人喜歡簡單粗暴地解決問題。

description.en: The Bone Cudgel is old enough to be considered an ancient treasure, but still menacing even by modern standards.
description.zh-Hant: 大骨棒非常古老，老到古董的程度，即使按現代標準，也仍然充滿危險。

traits.zh-Hant: 對災厄村民造成額外傷害

description.en: The Broken Sawblade has been ravaged by time, but it still does considerable damage.
description.zh-Hant: 破損鋸劍雖已遭時間蹂躪，但仍能造成巨大傷害。

description.en: The Mechanized Sawblade still glows from the fires of the Nether where it was forged.
description.zh-Hant: 機械鋸劍依然散發出來自下界其鍛造之處的火光。

description.en: A massive sword that seems impossibly heavy to lift yet rests easily in a just warrior's hands.
description.zh-Hant: 一把巨劍，看似難以舉起，卻能輕松地被一位純正的戰士握住。

description.en: Only those with the strength of a champion and the heart of a hero can carry this massive blade.
description.zh-Hant: 想要扛起這把大劍，頂尖力量和英雄之心缺一不可。

description.en: The legendary Frost Slayer returns to the battlefield only in the darkest and coldest days of winter.
description.zh-Hant: 這把傳說中的武器只會在冬季中最黑暗、寒冷的日子里重返戰地。

description.en: A lucky blacksmith turned a workshop blunder into a battlefield wonder, fusing two weapons into something new.
description.zh-Hant: 一個幸運的鐵匠把作坊的失誤變成了戰場的奇跡，將兩種武器融合到了一起。

traits.zh-Hant: 翻滾后提高下一擊傷害

description.en: Gifted to one of the Arch-Illager's most distinguished generals upon their conquest of the Squid Coast - this runeblade is infused with dark witchcraft.
description.zh-Hant: 這把符文之刃原是贈予一位傑出將軍的禮物；他曾率軍征服魷魚海岸。刀身注入了黑暗巫術。

description.en: The Coral Blade cuts through enemies with stinging accuracy.
description.zh-Hant: 珊瑚之刃能夠精準地刺穿敵人。

description.en: This blade may look colorless and dead, but it soaks up energy in combat and expels it in a powerful burst.
description.zh-Hant: 這把刀看起來色彩黯淡且死氣沉沉，但它可以在戰斗中吸收能量，并以強大的爆發力將其釋放。

traits.en: Deals absorbed damage during attack combo
traits.zh-Hant: 攻擊中造成額外吸收傷害

description.en: This curved blade, wielded by the warriors of the Squid Coast, requires a steady hand in battle.
description.zh-Hant: 魷魚海岸的武士們使用的武器，在戰斗中可千萬不能手抖。

description.en: Warriors who view battle as a dance with death prefer double-bladed swords.
description.zh-Hant: 把戰斗視作與死共舞的戰士們更喜歡這把雙刃劍。

description.en: This deadly blade's story was lost to the endless sands of time.
description.zh-Hant: 這把致命刀刃背后的故事，已被流沙般的時光掩埋了。

description.en: The Sparkler lights up the party as it cuts through the darkness.
description.zh-Hant: 煙花棒可在劃破黑暗的同時照亮整個派對。

description.en: Daggers are the weapon of cravens - or so folk say.
description.zh-Hant: 匕首是懦夫的武器 - 大概人們會這么說。

description.en: These lauded twin daggers of the northern mountains are known to freeze their foes to solid ice.
description.zh-Hant: 北方山區的人都知道這把備受稱贊的匕首能將敵人凍為堅冰。

description.en: These curved blades shine like the crescent moon on a dark night.
description.zh-Hant: 這些彎曲的刀刃像月牙一樣在黑夜中閃閃發光。

description.en: Even the simplest of farmers can wield these Shear Daggers with savage results.
description.zh-Hant: 即使是最樸素的農民，也可以用這把匕首造成殘暴的后果。

traits.zh-Hant: 最后一擊造成范圍傷害

description.en: A devastating weapon fit for barbaric fighters.
description.zh-Hant: 一種適合野蠻戰士的毀滅性武器。

description.en: This cursed, poisonous axe leaves their victims sick for years with just a single scratch.
description.zh-Hant: 只需輕輕一劃，這把含有詛咒和劇毒的斧頭就能使受害者臥床多年。

description.en: Whirlwind, forged during an epic windstorm, is a double-bladed axe that levitates slightly.
description.zh-Hant: 在一場史詩般的暴風雨中鍛造而成，是一把會輕輕漂浮的雙刃斧。

description.en: Gauntlets call back to an ancient style of hand to hand combat.
description.zh-Hant: 護手的歷史悠久，可以追溯到古時候的肉搏戰。

description.en: Made in the wilds beyond the mountains, these gauntlets have been worn by warriors for centuries.
description.zh-Hant: 這些護手是在山外的荒野中制作的，幾個世紀以來戰士們都戴著它們。

description.en: These claw-like weapons, wielded by ancient Illager soldiers, are savage in battle.
description.zh-Hant: 外觀形似爪子，曾由古代災厄士兵揮舞并顯露野蠻。

description.en: Soul Fists are gauntlets clad with great gemstones, each containing a powerful soul.
description.zh-Hant: 靈魂拳套是包裹著巨大寶石的護手，每顆寶石都蘊含著強大的靈魂。

description.en: The glaive, wielded by the servants of the Nameless One, is a weapon with style and power.
description.zh-Hant: 無名者的護衛使用的武器，具有獨特的風格和力量。

description.en: Sweep your enemies off their feet with the Cackling Broom.
description.zh-Hant: 用這把會怪笑的掃帚將敵人掃地出門。

traits.zh-Hant: 對亡靈生物造成額外傷害

description.en: A relic from ages of darkness; this glaive radiates potent magical energy to ward off the undead.
description.zh-Hant: 一個源自黑暗時代流傳下來的遺物，會散發出強大的魔法能量來免受亡靈生物的威脅。

traits.zh-Hant: 對亡靈生物造成額外傷害

description.en: A toxic cloud seems to follow the Venom Glaive wherever it goes...
description.zh-Hant: 有這把刀的地方就一定會彌漫著毒霧……

description.en: Blacksmiths and soldiers alike use the Great Hammer for its strength in forging and in battle.
description.zh-Hant: 鐵匠和士兵都使用大錘，在鍛造和戰場上力量十足。

description.en: Fashioned in the likeness of a familiar foe, this hammer pulls your opponents towards their doom.
description.zh-Hant: 這把戰錘以一名熟悉的敵人為原型打造，能將對手拉向毀滅。

description.en: A hammer, embedded with a crystal that harnesses the power of gravity, that is incredibly powerful.
description.zh-Hant: 一柄錘子，嵌有一顆能夠利用重力的水晶，威力驚人。

description.en: The Stormlander, enchanted with the power of the raging storm, is a treasure of the Illagers.
description.zh-Hant: 附有強大風暴之力的錘子，是災厄村民們的寶藏。

description.en: A blade fit for expert warriors and fighters, its blade is crafted to inflict precision damage.
description.zh-Hant: 一把適合專業戰士和武士的刀，其精心設計的刀刃可以確保直擊要害。

description.en: A blade that will not rest until the battle has been won.
description.zh-Hant: 一把永不停歇的武士刀，直到戰斗獲勝。

traits.zh-Hant: 對亡靈生物造成額外傷害

description.en: The Master's Katana has existed throughout the ages, appearing to heroes at the right moment.
description.zh-Hant: 大師的武士刀在任何年代都存在，會在合適的時機出現在英雄面前。

description.en: The Mace is a brutal tool of war and what it lacks in finesse; it makes up for in power.
description.zh-Hant: 釘錘是殘酷的戰爭工具；它雖不講究技巧，卻以威力彌補一切。

description.en: This ancient weapon inflicts grave blunt damage to those who cannot evade the deadly metal ball.
description.zh-Hant: 這種古老的武器會對那些無法躲避致命金屬球的人造成嚴重的鈍器傷害。

description.en: This mace, engraved with secret healing runes, grants powerful restorative powers.
description.zh-Hant: 刻著神秘治療符文的錘子，賦予了其強大的恢復能量。

description.en: This massive blade cleaves even the thickest shulker shells with style and ease.
description.zh-Hant: 這把巨型大劍可以輕松地劈開最厚的潛影殼。

description.en: The Starless Night is haunted by echoes of pain that linger within the pitch-black blade.
description.zh-Hant: 無星之夜被漆黑的刀刃內徘徊的痛苦回聲所包裹。

traits.zh-Hant: 把過高的傷害傳遞給附近的生物

description.en: The pickaxe has been the iconic tool of adventurers and heroes for as long as anyone can remember.
description.zh-Hant: 只要無人忘記，鎬子就是冒險家和英雄們必不可缺的工具。

description.en: Diamond is one of the most durable materials, making it an excellent choice for a pickaxe.
description.zh-Hant: 鉆石是最耐用的原材料之一，用來做一把鎬子再適合不過了。

traits.zh-Hant: 擊殺生物掉落更多綠寶石

description.en: A strange weapon that makes a sound that no creature from the Overworld has ever made.
description.zh-Hant: 一把奇特的武器，發出的聲音連主世界的任何生物都不曾聽過。

description.en: The rapier, a nimble and narrow blade, strikes with quick ferocity.
description.zh-Hant: 西洋劍，劍刃靈活狹長，出手又快又狠。

description.en: The Bee Stinger, a swift blade inspired by a bee's barb, can draw friendly bees into the fray to fight alongside you.
description.zh-Hant: 蜂刺是一把以蜜蜂螫針為靈感的迅捷利刃，能召來友善蜜蜂並肩作戰。

traits.zh-Hant: 擊殺生物后有概率召喚蜜蜂

description.en: This needle-like blade is ice cold to the touch and makes quick work of any cut.
description.zh-Hant: 這種針狀的花劍觸感冰涼，取敵首級如探囊取物。

description.en: A ceremonial weapon that hails from the same region as the Desert Temple.
description.zh-Hant: 一把儀式用武器，來自沙漠神殿所在的同一片區域。

description.en: The twin blades of Nightmare's Bite drip with deadly venom, still potent after all these years.
description.zh-Hant: 刀刃上毒液的致命性可經時間流逝而仍保持效果。

description.en: Strange, distorted laughter seems to whisper from these menacing looking sickles.
description.zh-Hant: 這把鐮刀似乎時不時傳出奇怪又扭曲的笑聲。

traits.zh-Hant: 擊殺生物掉落更多綠寶石

description.en: A ceremonial knife that uses magical energy to hold the wrath of souls inside its blade.
description.zh-Hant: 被災厄村民用于招魂儀式的工具，其中含有憤怒的靈魂。

description.en: A disturbing aura surrounds this knife, as if it has existed for all time and will outlive us all.
description.zh-Hant: 一個令人不安的光環圍繞著這把刀，仿佛它亙古而來，并終將不朽。

description.en: The warden of Highblock Keep kept this unpleasant blade by their side during interrogations.
description.zh-Hant: 高墩城堡的看守人會在審訊過程中將這把令人不爽的劍放在囚犯身邊。

traits.zh-Hant: 提升對受傷生物的傷害

description.en: A cruel reaper of souls, the Soul Scythe is unsentimental in its work.
description.zh-Hant: 殘酷的靈魂收割機，不需要任何感情。

description.en: The Frost Scythe is an indestructible blade that is freezing to the touch and never seems to melt.
description.zh-Hant: 一把牢不可破的鐮刀，摸起來很堅硬，刃上的冰似乎從未融化。

description.en: This scythe belonged to the terror of Highblock Keep, the Jailor.
description.zh-Hant: 這把鐮刀由高墩城堡的恐怖人物持有——獄卒。

description.en: Don't ask what unnatural creature's bones were used to build this weapon. You don't want to know.
description.zh-Hant: 千萬不要問這把武器是用什么非自然生物的骨頭做的。你肯定不想知道。

description.en: The spear, with its long reach and powerful range, is a solid choice of weapon.
description.zh-Hant: 長矛的射程很遠，范圍很廣，是一種可靠的選擇。

description.en: A spear that is watched over by lucky souls, bringing luck to any who wield it.
description.zh-Hant: 被幸運的靈魂守護著的一支長矛，為持有者帶來好運。

description.en: The creator of this terrible weapon was said to have an affinity for giant eyes. Thankfully, this weapon was the extent of their madness.
description.zh-Hant: 據說這把可怕武器的製作者對巨眼情有獨鍾。所幸，這把武器已是其瘋狂行徑的極限。

description.en: Legend says that this cursed spear is plagued by a soul that controls the mind of any who wield it.
description.zh-Hant: 傳說這把被詛咒的長矛有一個靈魂附身其中，可以控制任何使用-{}-者的思想。

description.en: This knife slices through enemies like the wind that cuts between the mountaintops.
description.zh-Hant: 這把刀切割敵人猶如在兩峰之間切割出峽谷一樣簡單。

traits.zh-Hant: 擊敗生物后大幅提高速度

description.en: Crafted from the never-melting ice atop the mountain peaks, this knife is forever icy to the touch.
description.zh-Hant: 由山峰上從未融化的冰鑄造而成，寒冷刺骨之意經久不衰。

traits.zh-Hant: 擊敗生物后大幅提高速度

description.en: Passed down by nomads who roam the mountain peaks, this knife has been used in countless battles.
description.zh-Hant: 這把刀傳承自山峰上的游牧民族，歷經了無數次戰爭。

traits.zh-Hant: 擊敗生物后大幅提高速度
提升對受傷生物的傷害

description.en: These Blades are infused with a disturbing purpose after countless ages trapped in the End.
description.zh-Hant: 這把刀刃封印在末地中無數年后，被注入了一種令人不安的意念。

description.en: Forged by the survivors of a doomed expedition to the End, these twin blades carry dark secrets.
description.zh-Hant: 這把雙刃由命中注定前往末地遠征的生還者鍛造，攜帶著黑暗的秘密。

description.en: A whip made of sturdy rope, very dangerous in the right hands.
description.zh-Hant: 用堅固的繩索制成的鞭子，用對方法可以造成巨大傷害。

description.en: A sturdy whip made from thick, thorn-laden vines capable of poisoning anything it touches. Be careful not to scratch yourself!
description.zh-Hant: 用厚實又長滿尖-{}-刺的藤蔓制成的堅固鞭子，能夠使觸到的任何東西中-{}-毒。注意不要劃傷自己！

description.en: A simple but well-rounded piece of weaponry. The hunters of the Pumpkin Pastures say that a bow doesn't let you down, unlike other trinkets.
description.zh-Hant: 一件簡單而全面的武器。 南瓜牧場的獵人說弓不會讓你失望，而不像其他的小飾品。

description.en: The Bonebow is the pride of Pumpkin Pastures, crafted within the walls of their humble village.
description.zh-Hant: 骨弓雖然由城墻內一個不起眼的村莊制作而成，但卻成了南瓜牧場的驕傲。

description.en: What indescribable horror! The creeping tentacles of this bow reach for the unknowable Void.
description.zh-Hant: 無法形容的恐怖，這把弓上毛骨悚然的觸手可以伸往未知的虛空！

description.en: The Twin Bow is the champion of the hero who finds themselves outnumbered and alone.
description.zh-Hant: 這把弓是專門為出眾但又孤獨的英雄所準備的。

description.en: Let your troubles float away with the Bubble Bow, which seals your target in a bubble on a charged shot.
description.zh-Hant: 讓煩惱隨氣泡弓飄散吧，它的蓄力一擊可以把你的目標封在泡泡里面。

description.en: The Bubble Burster creates a chain effect of bubble trouble for your enemies.
description.zh-Hant: 氣泡爆裂弓可為你的敵人制造連鎖泡泡陣效應。

traits.zh-Hant: 蓄力后可命中多個目標

description.en: Entrap your enemies in a strange, syrupy bubble and show them who's boss!
description.zh-Hant: 把敵人困在奇異黏稠的泡泡裡，讓他們知道誰才是老大！

traits.zh-Hant: 蓄力后可命中多個目標

description.en: A tactical crossbow favored by warriors and hunters alike, the Burst Crossbow is a powerful tool for any hero.
description.zh-Hant: 作為戰士和獵人都喜歡的戰術弩，爆裂弩在任何英雄手中都是一把強力工具。

description.en: This crossbow has a subtle but corrupting power that is suitable for thieves and nimble warriors alike.
description.zh-Hant: 這把弩有一種機巧而腐化的力量，既適合盜賊，又適合靈活的戰士。

traits.zh-Hant: 翻滾后提高下一擊傷害

description.en: This crossbow, crafted in a forge rich with souls, thrives when an abundance of souls are nearby.
description.zh-Hant: 這把弩是在富含靈魂的鍛爐中制成的，當附近有大量的靈魂時，就會茁壯成長。

description.en: The gears of this ancient Cog Crossbow still turn smoothly, making it a reliable weapon choice to this day.
description.zh-Hant: 這把古老的齒輪弩至今仍能平滑轉動，依然是把可靠的武器。

description.en: Found in the farthest reaches of the Nether, the Pride of the Piglins is both vintage and vicious.
description.zh-Hant: 一把既有年頭又兇殘的武器，發現于下界的最遠端。

description.en: The crossbow is the ranged weapon of the Illagers and is a common sight among Pillager warriors.
description.zh-Hant: 弩是災厄村民的遠程武器，常見于掠奪者戰士之間。

description.en: If the color blue had a sound, it would be the shots fired by the Azure Seeker.
description.zh-Hant: 如果聽到聲音時看到一抹藍，那一定是蔚藍探索者的射擊。

description.en: The peak of mischievous Illager-engineering, the famous Slicer was designed to fire bolts that pierce through even the thickest of armor.
description.zh-Hant: 穿刺者是喜歡搞惡作劇的災厄工程師的巔峰之作，設計上甚至能擊穿最厚實的盔甲。

description.en: Dual crossbows are the perfect choice for a warrior with quick reflexes in a fast-paced battle.
description.zh-Hant: 雙持弩是需要應對快節奏戰斗的戰士能夠迅速反應的完美需求。

description.en: While some dismiss the cute Baby Crossbows, these deadly weapons grow into heavy hitters.
description.zh-Hant: 忽略了迷你弩的后果，就是變成了一個勢不可擋的物體并造成致命的結果。

description.en: Enchanted enemies are especially vulnerable to the magic of these crossbows.
description.zh-Hant: 這些充滿魔法的弩會對附魔的敵人造成更多的傷害。

traits.zh-Hant: 對附魔敵人造成額外傷害

description.en: The power of TNT fused with the latest in archery design resulted in this devastating crossbow.
description.zh-Hant: TNT的能量和最新的箭術設計融合在一起，形成了這個毀滅性的弩。

description.en: The Firebolt Thrower launches chaos in a chain reaction of exploding arrows.
description.zh-Hant: 射出去的爆炸箭無疑能造成一連串的混亂。

description.en: The Imploding Crossbow has been magically fine-tuned to maximize the impact of the explosion.
description.zh-Hant: 聚爆弩已經進行了魔法般的細調，以最大程度地發揮爆炸的威力。

description.en: The Harpoon Crossbow shoots harpoons that cut through wind and water with devastating power.
description.zh-Hant: 漁叉射擊的破壞性力量足以劃破風和水。

description.en: Why harpoon one enemy when you can harpoon many!
description.zh-Hant: 如果能用漁叉攻擊多個敵人，為什么要只盯著一個敵人看呢！

description.en: The weighted crossbow is a damage-dealing menace and a real threat from a ranged distance.
description.zh-Hant: 加重過的弩帶來了真正的威脅性，能在范圍內造成巨大傷害。

description.en: Many thought that the Doom Crossbow was just a myth, but this time the rumors turned out to be true.
description.zh-Hant: 許多人認為末日弩只是一個神話，但這次謠言變成了事實。

description.en: The Slayer Crossbow is the treasured heirloom of many legendary hunters.
description.zh-Hant: 殺戮之弩是許多傳奇獵人的珍貴傳家寶。

description.en: This enchanted bow strengthens the bond between the hunter and their animal companion.
description.zh-Hant: 這把附魔的弓強化了獵人與他們信賴的動物伙伴之間的友誼。

traits.zh-Hant: 寵物會優先攻擊所選生物

description.en: The Ancient Bow is still as sprightly as the day it was first strung.
description.zh-Hant: 這把弓仍像被鑄起而成的那一天一樣嶄新。

traits.zh-Hant: 寵物會優先攻擊所選生物
翻滾后提高下一擊傷害

description.en: This enchanted bow deepens the bond between the hunter and their trusted animal companion.
description.zh-Hant: 這把附魔的弓加深了獵人與他們信賴的動物伙伴之間的友誼。

traits.zh-Hant: 寵物會優先攻擊所選生物

description.en: The bow prefered by the masters of archery across the Overworld, no matter how simple it appears.
description.zh-Hant: 這是箭術大師們都喜歡用的弓，因為簡單好用。

traits.zh-Hant: 寵物會優先攻擊所選生物

description.en: The Longbow, crafted for hunting rather than battle, is still useful in a fight.
description.zh-Hant: 長弓是為打獵而設計的，但用在戰斗中也很合適。

description.en: Forged from fossilized coral, the Guardian Bow is a remnant from sunken civilizations of lost ages.
description.zh-Hant: 由石化珊瑚鍛造而成的守衛者之弓是失落歲月中淪落文明的遺留物。

description.en: The Red Snake radiates an explosive heat, making it a deadly fire risk in the dry, desert lands.
description.zh-Hant: 紅蛇無時無刻都在釋放爆炸性的能量，沙漠中致命的火災極有可能來源于此。

description.en: The question of what makes the Power Bow so powerful has puzzled the minds of learned folk for ages.
description.zh-Hant: 這把弓如此強大的原因一直都在困擾著人們。

description.en: The secrets of the Elite Power Bow's construction have been lost without a trace.
description.zh-Hant: 關于精英力量弓構造的秘密早已消失得無影無蹤。

description.en: The arrows that take flight from the Phantom Bow swoop down on your enemies like the bow's nightmarish namesake.
description.zh-Hant: 從幻翼弓中射出的箭矢會如其惡名一般，朝敵人疾速飛去。

description.en: This bow, built for a long-lost champion, feels right in the hands of those who seek justice.
description.zh-Hant: 這把弓是為一位失落已久的冠軍打造的，追求正義的人都認為它十分稱手。

description.en: New reloading technology helps this crossbow fire more rapidly than those that came before it.
description.zh-Hant: 新的裝填技術比以前更有效地幫助了弩的射擊。

description.en: The Arch-Illager said the design for this powerful crossbow came to him in a vision.
description.zh-Hant: 奇厄教主說，這個強大的弩的設計是他在幻象中見到的。

description.en: This crossbow moves faster than wings in flight and strikes down enemies before they see the bolt.
description.zh-Hant: 這把弩的射擊速度甚至能快過飛行中的翅膀，在敵人反應過來前就能殺死目標。

description.en: This crossbow, modified to hold and fire multiple bolts, is also a half-decent musical instrument.
description.zh-Hant: 這種弩經過了改裝，可以裝載并發射多發箭矢，同時也算是半件樂器。

description.en: Half musical instrument and fully deadly weapon, the Harp Crossbow is the life of the party.
description.zh-Hant: 音樂與致命的完美結合，是聚會中不可或缺的東西。

description.en: Adding electrical energy to this crossbow changed the firing sound dramatically.
description.zh-Hant: 閃電的力量極大地改變了這張弩發射時的聲音。

description.en: Those who wish to use the Shadow Crossbow must train in total darkness before wielding it.
description.zh-Hant: 想要揮舞暗影弩，必先在完全的黑暗中進行訓練。

traits.en: Chance of shadow form on kills
traits.zh-Hant: 擊殺時概率觸發暗影狀態效果

description.en: As you wield this unsettling weapon, you might find yourself succumbing to the darkness and becoming one with the night.
description.zh-Hant: 揮舞這把令人不安的武器時，你可能會逐漸沉入黑暗，與夜色融為一體。

traits.en: Chance of shadow form on kills
traits.zh-Hant: 擊殺時概率觸發暗影狀態效果

traits.en: First shot does not break shadow form
traits.zh-Hant: 下次射擊不會打破暗影狀態效果

description.en: The Veiled Crossbow cloaks the wielder in shadow, perfect for those who prefer to go unnoticed (and undefeated).
description.zh-Hant: 這把隱蔽的弩會把持有者籠罩在陰影中，是偏好不被發現（和不被擊敗）的人的最佳選擇。

traits.en: Chance of shadow form on kills
traits.zh-Hant: 擊殺時概率觸發暗影狀態效果

traits.en: First shot does not break shadow form
traits.zh-Hant: 下次射擊不會打破暗影狀態效果

description.en: The preferred weapon of thieves and rogues, the Shortbow is nimble and lethal at short range.
description.zh-Hant: 盜賊和流氓的喜愛，在短距離射程中靈活且致命。

description.en: Love can be magical, but when it becomes too powerful, it can turn into a frenzy.
description.zh-Hant: 愛情可以很神奇，但只要能量溢出，就會開始發狂。

description.en: A brand new development in quick firing technology, this bow packs a swift punch.
description.zh-Hant: 快速射擊技術的全新發展，給這把弓加上了快速箭頭。

description.en: Named the Purple Storm after its lovely hue, this legendary bow packs a powerful punch.
description.zh-Hant: 因其可愛的顏色被命名為“紫色風暴”，具有強大的沖擊力。

description.en: Those who face the Snow Bow in battle must also prepare to face the chill of freezing wintry winds.
description.zh-Hant: 在戰斗中與冰雪之弓交戰的人還必須做好面對寒風的凍結效果。

description.en: Crafted from the webs of mighty spiders, the Webbed Bow will get you out of any sticky situation.
description.zh-Hant: 蛛網弓由強韌的蛛網制作而成，助你擺脫一切膠著狀況。

description.en: Arrows fired from this legendary bow are said to be carried by the winter winds themselves.
description.zh-Hant: 由這把傳奇之弓發射的箭據傳內含冬風特有的屬性。

description.en: The Soul Bow shimmers with all the beauty and fury of an attacking Vex.
description.zh-Hant: 靈魂之弓散發著美麗的熒光，以及一個正在攻擊的惱鬼所帶來的憤怒。

description.en: This bow, made of cursed bones, strips the living of their very souls.
description.zh-Hant: 這把弓是用被詛咒過的骨頭制作的，會剝奪生命的靈魂。

description.en: The souls bound to the bow guide the arrows to their targets and cause it to glow slightly.
description.zh-Hant: 束縛在箭頭上的靈魂會將引向目標，并使目標發光。

description.en: The Shivering Bow pierces even the most ancient ice and strikes a chill into the heart of any enemy.
description.zh-Hant: 寒顫弓可以刺穿最古老的冰，把寒顫打入敵人心底。

description.en: The Soul Crossbow was crafted by the mysterious Evokers and Enchanters of the Woodland Mansions.
description.zh-Hant: 靈魂弩是由林地府邸中神秘的喚魔者與附魔師制作的。

description.en: If you listen closely you can hear the souls inside the crossbow, usually ridiculing you.
description.zh-Hant: 如果你靠得足夠近，你就能聽到這把弩中靈魂的聲音，通常是嘲笑你的聲音。

description.en: This weapon calls out to souls that are trapped between this world and the next.
description.zh-Hant: 這個武器在呼喚困在本世界與下個世界之間的靈魂。

description.en: No one knows how these bows were made, if it was originally a spider first or a magical crossbow.
description.zh-Hant: 沒人知道這些弓是如何製成的，也不知道最初究竟是蜘蛛，還是魔法弩。

description.en: A sleek bow that seems to never miss its target.
description.zh-Hant: 一把光滑的弓，似乎從未錯失它的目標。

description.en: The arrows fired from the Green Menace always hit their intended target, even in the thickest fog.
description.zh-Hant: 翠綠之殤可以穿過重重濃霧并確保命中目標。

description.en: It would be a deadly mistake to underestimate the power of the Pink Scoundrel.
description.zh-Hant: 低估粉紅惡棍的后果可是致命的。

description.en: This candy-colored bow has a surprisingly bitter bite.
description.zh-Hant: 讓人意想不到的是，這把糖果色的弓會讓人嘗到苦澀的滋味。

description.en: This bow writhes within your grasp as if trying to wrap its tendrils around everything in its path.
description.zh-Hant: 弓在你的掌控中彎曲蠕動，仿佛要用觸手纏住一切擋道之處。

description.en: The Weeping Vine Bow's toxic vines create a poisonous haze on the battlefield.
description.zh-Hant: 垂淚藤蔓弓的毒藤會在戰場上釋放一片毒霧。

description.en: When you pluck the string of the Void Bow, an unsettling silence reverberates across the battlefield.
description.zh-Hant: 當你拉撥虛空之弓的弦時，一股坐立不安的寂靜將充斥整個戰場。

description.en: You can feel the Void whispering from deep within this bow, but behind that sound is another voice in the darkness.
description.zh-Hant: 你能感受到這把弓深藏虛空的低語，但與此同時在它背后還存在著另一個黑暗中的聲音。

description.en: A mesmerizing bow that captures the power of the wind to fire mighty Gale Arrows.
description.zh-Hant: 一把令人著迷的弓，捕捉狂風的能量來發射強大的風之箭矢。

description.en: A bow infused with the force of a rolling wind which can flare up in an instant.
description.zh-Hant: 一把注入了強大風滾能量的弓，可以在瞬間進行爆發。

traits.zh-Hant: 翻滾后蓄力接下來的射擊

description.en: This bow calls upon the twisting winds of the hidden valley where it was first strung.
description.zh-Hant: 這把弓會與最初上弦時隱藏在山谷之中的扭曲之風交相呼應。

description.en: The Battle Robe is worn by the distinguished Illager Evokers of the Arch-Illager's court.
description.zh-Hant: 戰袍由奇厄教主法庭上杰出的喚魔者穿戴。

description.en: The distinguished Splendid Robe is worn by the hardened Illager warriors who protect the Arch-Illager.
description.zh-Hant: 尊貴的華麗長袍由守護 Arch-Illager 的精銳劫掠者戰士穿著。

description.en: There always seems to be a slight buzz around the Beenest Armor. Or maybe the buzz is coming from within?
description.zh-Hant: 蜂巢護甲的周圍似乎總有輕微的嗡嗡聲。又或者，這種嗡嗡聲其實來自于護甲內部？

traits.en: 30% chance to summon a bee when hit (max 3)
traits.zh-Hant: 被攻擊時有30%的概率召喚一只蜜蜂（最多3只）
可將治療藥水用于附近隊友

description.en: The Beehive Armor hums with the focused power of countless bees.
description.zh-Hant: 蜂箱護甲在無數蜜蜂的齊心協力下嗡嗡作響。

traits.en: 30% chance to summon a bee when hit (max 3)

traits.zh-Hant: 被攻擊時有30%的概率召喚一只蜜蜂（最多3只）
可將治療藥水用于附近隊友

description.en: Granted to the champions of the Overworld by the free villagers as a token of their thanks for many years of protection and assistance. The mark of a true hero.
description.zh-Hant: 由全部自由的村民共同授予世界守護者的護甲。以感謝這些年的保護和幫助。真正的英雄才配有此物。

description.en: Only given to the highest caliber of heroes, the Hero's Armor is a precious gift from the Villagers.
description.zh-Hant: 這是村民贈予頂尖英雄的珍貴禮物，只有最出色的英雄才配擁有。

traits.zh-Hant: 可將治療藥水用于附近隊友

description.en: This sturdy Climbing Gear is perfect for braving the blistering cold of the icy mountain face.
description.zh-Hant: 這件結實的護裝非常適合對抗冰山上凜冽的寒冷。

traits.en: Resists any form of knockback by 75%

description.en: Made from the pelts of Mountain Goats, you'll feel like skipping from peak to peak in this Goat Gear.
description.zh-Hant: 用山羊的毛皮制作而成，穿戴后會感覺到跳躍感猶如可以從一個山峰蹦到另一個山峰一樣輕浮。

traits.en: Resists any form of knockback by 75%

description.en: Take on the worst that nature can throw at you in this rugged armor.
description.zh-Hant: 穿上這套堅固的護甲，去迎接大自然的兇極險惡吧。

traits.en: Resists any form of knockback by 75%
traits.zh-Hant: 減免75%任何形式造成的擊退效果

description.en: Dark Armor, made in the blackest depths of the Fiery Forge, is worn by the Illager royal guard.
description.zh-Hant: 在熾熱熔爐最黑暗的深處制造的暗黑盔甲，是由皇家災厄軍隊穿戴的。

description.en: The inspiring tales of the Titan's Shroud armor have passed through Pumpkin Pastures for generations.
description.zh-Hant: 關于泰坦鋼盔的勵志故事，已經在南瓜牧場上流傳了好幾代。

description.en: As you wear the Emerald Gear during your adventures, it calls other emeralds to you as if by chance.
description.zh-Hant: 在冒險中穿戴綠寶石盔甲時，它會把其他綠寶石召喚出來給你，就像是偶然撿到那樣。

traits.en: Chance to spawn emeralds when exploring
traits.zh-Hant: 探索中有概率生成綠寶石

description.en: Even death itself has to pause and admire the charms of the legendary Gilded Glory armor.
description.zh-Hant: 即便是死亡本身也經不住這件傳奇盔甲的魅力而駐足觀賞。

traits.en: Chance to spawn emeralds when exploring
traits.zh-Hant: 探索時有概率生成綠寶石

traits.en: Can spend emeralds to cheat death
traits.zh-Hant: 花費綠寶石來騙過死神

description.en: Opulent Armor, originally designed more for show than for combat, thrives in the presence of Emeralds.
description.zh-Hant: 此甲設計之初更多地是為了展示而不是戰斗，但在綠寶石的影響下逐漸發生變化。

traits.en: Chance to spawn emeralds when exploring

traits.zh-Hant: 探索中有概率生成綠寶石

description.en: Defensive? Sure. Fabulous? ABSOLUTELY.
description.zh-Hant: 防護一流？那是當然。精致華麗？本該如此。

traits.zh-Hant: 可將治療藥水用于附近隊友
+30% 正面狀態效果持續時間

description.en: Why leave your adoring fans wanting more when you can wow them with this inspirational outfit?
description.zh-Hant: 如果能用這套鼓舞人心的裝束讓崇拜者拍手叫絕，那為何不給他們更多驚嘆呢？

traits.zh-Hant: -30% 負面狀態效果持續時間
可將治療藥水用于附近隊友
+30% 正面狀態效果持續時間

description.en: Potent magical runes are weaved into the fabric of these robes, their origins and true powers are shrouded in mystery.
description.zh-Hant: 強大的魔法符文被編織進這件長袍的織物中，它們的起源和力量被神秘地掩蓋了。

description.en: The Ember Robe was created by Illager Evokers to distinguish themselves from the common guard.
description.zh-Hant: 灰燼長袍是喚魔者為了區別于其他災厄村民而創造的。

description.en: Those who don the Verdant Robe soon find that they can commune with more souls than ever before.
description.zh-Hant: 穿著碧綠長袍的人很快就會發現，他們可以與更多的靈魂進行溝通。

description.en: Those who wear Ghostly Armor may feel their bodies briefly disconnect from the physical world, but are quickly snapped back to reality.
description.zh-Hant: 身著幽靈盔甲的人有時會感覺到自己的身體與物理世界短暫隔絕，但很快就被喚回了現實。

traits.en: Briefly gain Ghost Form when rolling
traits.zh-Hant: 翻滾時短暫獲得幽靈形態

description.en: Shroud your scary skeletal form with a creepy cloak, still spooky!
description.zh-Hant: 用陰森斗篷遮住你可怕的骷髏身形，依然毛骨悚然！

traits.en: Briefly gain Ghost Form when rolling
traits.zh-Hant: 翻滾時短暫獲得幽靈形態

description.en: Strange flames follow the shifting form of those who wear the Ghost Kindler armor.
description.zh-Hant: 詭-{}-異的火焰會隨穿戴者身形而貼身變化。

traits.en: Briefly gain Ghost Form when rolling
traits.zh-Hant: 翻滾時短暫獲得幽靈形態

description.en: Grim Armor invokes a sense of dread for the one who wears it and to those who face it in battle.
description.zh-Hant: 冷酷盔甲令穿著者與戰場上的敵人都感到恐懼。

description.en: Those who wear the mantle of The Spooky Gourdian become the legendary terror of Pumpkin Pastures!
description.zh-Hant: 穿上驚悚南瓜披風，成為南瓜牧場上的傳奇恐怖之源！

description.en: Wither Armor, crafted with the parts of slain enemies, was made to terrify the wearer's enemies.
description.zh-Hant: 用擊殺敵人的肢體所制成的盔甲，可以有效震懾穿戴者的敵人。

description.en: Cheap armor made in bulk, the Guard's Armor is a common sight in the villages of the Overworld.
description.zh-Hant: 大量製造的廉價盔甲，在主世界的村莊裡隨處可見。

description.en: No one knows where this strange armor came from but it seems familiar to you.
description.zh-Hant: 沒人知道這件奇異盔甲從何而來，但你似乎對它感到熟悉。

description.en: Hunter's Armor may not be the fanciest gear around, but it will stop a blade.
description.zh-Hant: 雖然看起來平淡無奇，但他可以防御劍的砍擊。

description.en: Archer's Armor, favored by humble warriors, is cheap to make and still stops a blade.
description.zh-Hant: 謙虛勇士們的最愛，既便宜又足以護身。

description.en: Mercenary Armor, favored by those looking to save some coin, lacks flair but gets the job done.
description.zh-Hant: 受想省錢的人青睞的傭兵盔甲雖不華麗，卻能完成任務。

description.en: Donning this armor brings great power, but along with that power comes a hunger that can never be satisfied...
description.zh-Hant: 穿上這套盔甲會獲得強大力量，但也會伴隨永遠無法滿足的飢餓……

description.en: When you wear this cloak, the sounds of screams fill the air. But are the screams yours, or your enemies'?
description.zh-Hant: 穿上這件斗篷後，四周會響起陣陣尖叫。但那是你的尖叫，還是敵人的？

description.en: Renegade Armor made a fine payment for mercenaries hired to protect the villages against Illagers.
description.zh-Hant: 叛節盔甲曾是傭兵的豐厚報酬，他們受雇保護村莊免遭劫掠者侵襲。

description.en: Some blacksmiths see the design influence of Iron Golems in this property-shifting armor.
description.zh-Hant: 有些鐵匠認為，這件能改變屬性的盔甲，其設計靈感來自鐵魔像。

description.en: You feel a rush of pure adrenaline surge through your body when you wear this Ocelot's pelt.
description.zh-Hant: 穿上這件豹貓獸皮衣時，會感覺到一股純粹的腎上腺素涌過你的身體。

description.en: The legendary black Ocelot was as graceful as it was deadly. When you wear its pelt, you feel like your enemies are left chasing your shadow.
description.zh-Hant: 傳說中的黑豹優雅而致命。披上牠的毛皮後，你會覺得敵人只能追著你的影子跑。

description.en: This armor, crafted from the bones of Phantoms, is a terrifying sight on the battlefield.
description.zh-Hant: 這件用幽靈的骨頭制成的盔甲，在戰場上令人恐懼。

description.en: Frost Bite remembers the icy winds which once flowed beneath the wings of mighty Phantoms.
description.zh-Hant: 冰霜之吻令人憶起強大的幻翼翅膀下曾卷起的刺骨寒風。

description.en: Wearing this Piglin Armor is almost enough to make one feel at home in the Nether. Almost.
description.zh-Hant: 穿上這件盔甲，就可以感覺到在下界如同在家一樣。基本上。

traits.en: Reset artifact cooldown on potion use
traits.zh-Hant: 使用藥水后重置法器冷卻時間

description.en: The Golden Piglin Armor combines a piglin's two favorite things: not dying and gold.
description.zh-Hant: 黃金豬靈盔甲融合了豬靈的兩種喜好：不死和黃金。

traits.en: Reset artifact cooldown on potion use
traits.zh-Hant: 使用藥水后重置法器冷卻時間

traits.en: Can get consumable on potion use
traits.zh-Hant: 使用藥水后獲得消耗品

description.en: Plate armor turns the average soldier into a fortress but comes with reduced mobility.
description.zh-Hant: 板甲能讓普通士兵化身堡壘，代價是行動變得遲緩。

description.en: The Cauldron Armor was created with camouflage in mind, but what it lacks in stealth it makes up for in bubbly charm.
description.zh-Hant: 鍋釜怪盔甲在設計之初就著眼于偽裝的功效，而潛行方面的笨重恰巧可以讓美到冒泡的魅力來彌補。

description.en: Full Metal Armor is destined for the great defenders of the Overworld.
description.zh-Hant: 穿上這個盔甲的人注定要成為這個世界的偉大守護者。

description.en: Mostly worn by casual adventurers, Reinforced Mail is a common sight throughout the land.
description.zh-Hant: 強化鎖子甲多由休閒冒險者穿著，在各地十分常見。

description.en: This reliable armor is sturdy enough to be passed down for generations.
description.zh-Hant: 這件可靠又堅固的盔甲足以代代相傳。

traits.zh-Hant: 使用藥水可提升防御力

description.en: Twisted roots form this aberrant armor, its malevolent nature evident.
description.zh-Hant: 扭曲的根鬚構成這件異變盔甲，邪惡氣息顯而易見。

traits.en: Reset artifact cooldown on potion use
traits.zh-Hant: 使用藥水后重置法器冷卻時間
可將治療藥水用于附近隊友

description.en: This decaying armor has an unsettling presence, as if observing you.
description.zh-Hant: 這件腐朽盔甲散發令人不安的氣息，彷彿正注視著你。

traits.en: Reset artifact cooldown on potion use
traits.zh-Hant: 使用藥水后重置法器冷卻時間
可將治療藥水用于附近隊友

description.en: This armor, crafted near the shores of a great sea, was inspired by the scales of fish.
description.zh-Hant: 這件盔甲在大海岸邊打造，以魚鱗為靈感。

description.en: A wise armorer made this armor with care.
description.zh-Hant: 一位睿智的盔甲匠細心打造了這件盔甲。

description.en: Shulker Armor rivals even the toughest steel plate.
description.zh-Hant: 潛影貝盔甲的硬度可以媲美最堅硬的鋼板。

traits.zh-Hant: 被圍攻時降低所受傷害

description.en: They say the best defense is a good offense, but good luck breaking through this bulwark.
description.zh-Hant: 他們說最好的防守就是一發漂亮的進攻，但對于這個壘殼，大概只能祝你好運了。

traits.zh-Hant: 被圍攻時降低所受傷害

traits.en: Fire shulker projectiles at nearby enemies
traits.zh-Hant: 向附近敵人發射潛影貝導彈

description.en: A suit of armor that was tempered in snowmelt, protecting the wearer from the harsh cold of the tundra.
description.zh-Hant: 這套盔甲經融雪淬鍊，可保護穿戴者免受凍原酷寒侵襲。

description.en: This legendary armor, forged from ice that never melts, makes the wearer feel as if they are one with winter.
description.zh-Hant: 這件傳奇盔甲由永不融化的冰塊鍛造而成，讓穿戴者感覺仿佛與冬天融為一體。

description.en: Wiki does not provide an in-game description.
description.zh-Hant: Wiki 未提供遊戲內說明。

description.en: In a particular light, the souls woven into the cloth of the Soul Robe shimmer with power.
description.zh-Hant: 在特定光線下，編織進靈魂長袍布料中的靈魂會閃耀著力量。

description.en: The Souldancer Robe comes alive in the light, as if the souls within are dancing for all eternity.
description.zh-Hant: 魂舞長袍在陽光下顯得活力十足，好像里面的靈魂永遠在舞動。

description.en: The Spelunker Armor is worn by those who brave the darkest depths of the Overworld.
description.zh-Hant: 敢于踏入世界上最深處的人都會穿這件盔甲。

description.en: The Cave Crawler armor has been passed down through generations of brave spelunkers and miners.
description.zh-Hant: 深穴開拓者盔甲，已經被一代又一代勇敢的洞穴探險者和礦工傳承下來。

description.en: This armor may look like a piece of cake to your enemies, but it is surprisingly durable in battle. Must be the fondant.
description.zh-Hant: 這塊小蛋糕在敵人看來簡直可以輕松碾壓——但是在戰斗中卻意外堅固。不用想，肯定是翻糖外殼的功勞。

traits.zh-Hant: 給予玩家一隻寵物蝙蝠

description.en: The dark vines of the Sprout Armor continue to grow even in complete darkness.
description.zh-Hant: 護甲上的黑暗藤蔓在暗無天日的環境下也能生長。

traits.zh-Hant: 可將治療藥水用于附近隊友

traits.en: Traps and poisons nearby mobs when rolling
traits.zh-Hant: 翻滾時困住附近生物并給予劇毒

description.en: This armor is made from the living vines of a plant which grows only on battlefields.
description.zh-Hant: 這件護甲僅用生長在戰場上的藤蔓活制而成。

traits.zh-Hant: 可將治療藥水用于附近隊友

traits.en: Traps and poisons nearby mobs when rolling
traits.zh-Hant: 翻滾時困住附近生物并給予劇毒

description.en: It was easy to make this jet-black armor look cool. The hard part was securing the ink sacs.
description.zh-Hant: 讓這種烏黑的盔甲看起來很酷是件容易的事。難的是確保墨囊不受損傷。

traits.en: Release an ink cloud when rolling

description.en: Those who hunt elusive glow squids wear this armor to blend in with their beautiful prey.
description.zh-Hant: 穿上這種盔甲，就能混入捉摸不透的發光魷魚之中，并獵殺這個漂亮的獵物。

traits.en: Release an ink cloud when rolling

description.en: The Teleportation Robes were made by those who devoted their lives to studying the enigmas of the End.
description.zh-Hant: 傳送長袍是由畢生致力于研究末地之謎的人制作的。

description.en: This Enderobe sparks with static as you sashay across the battlefield.
description.zh-Hant: 這件長袍會在你穿越戰場時發出靜電火花。

description.en: This armor is light, nimble, and smells faintly of sulfur.
description.zh-Hant: 這件盔甲輕盈靈活，還隱約帶著硫磺味。

description.en: Spider Armor, created by master thieves, is inspired by the agile talents of the Spider.
description.zh-Hant: 蜘蛛盔甲由技藝高超的竊賊打造，靈感來自蜘蛛敏捷的身手。

description.en: The Turtle Armor is inspired by the hardy and protective shell of the humble turtle.
description.zh-Hant: 龜甲的靈感來自于謙卑烏龜的堅韌和堅硬的外殼。

description.en: This armor is made from the dense (but surprisingly light) shells of turtles who lived at crushing depths.
description.zh-Hant: 這件盔甲是用生活在不定深度的海龜的結實（但出乎意料地輕）外殼制成的。

description.en: Many warriors wear the heads of wolves into battle to strike fear into the hearts of their enemies.
description.zh-Hant: 許多戰士會戴上狼頭作戰，藉此嚇阻敵人。

traits.zh-Hant: 生命藥水可治療附近的隊友

description.en: If you want to survive the icy tundra in style, the Arctic Fox Armor is the best choice this season.
description.zh-Hant: 如果你想在冰原上過的風光，北極狐護甲是最佳的選擇。

traits.zh-Hant: 可用生命藥水治療附近隊友

description.en: The wolf who strikes from the shadows lives to tell the tale.
description.zh-Hant: 這個盔甲講述了一頭狼從陰影中活著走出來的故事。

traits.zh-Hant: 可將治療藥水用于附近隊友

description.en: Ancient Villager tribes created this armor to honor the fox, who is a great and agile warrior.
description.zh-Hant: 古代村民部落創造了這種盔甲來紀念那個偉大而敏捷的狐貍戰士。

traits.zh-Hant: 可將治療藥水用于附近隊友
